description: Election Commission - Mr. M. P. H. Kularathna of the Bingiriya Predeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Bingiriya Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to ceasing membership in a political alliance. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and is issued by the Returning Officer, making it directly related to electoral processes and the administration of local government elections.
